_guide.general: all hits consume posture! be careful.
_guide.standing: five element fist. Stores which state you are in and transitions to the next state after each hit
_guide.sprinting: charge with guard frames, skip 2 states
_guide.guard counter: a flurry of fast jabs that deal very little damage but pin for an extended period of time. At max spirit, omae wa mou shindeiru.
_guide.throw: consume spirit to throw random items that are capable of breaching
